Uniform Euclidean volume on the ordinal-sum antichain poset A_p⊕A_q⊕A_p is obtained by choosing N=2p+q iid uniform order statistics then uniformly permuting the first p, next q and last p rank values within their blocks. The exact covariance of sorted uniforms Cov(U_(r),U_(s))=min(r,s)(N+1−max(r,s))/((N+1)²(N+2)) and exact two-rank squared spacing d(d+1)/D imply outer zero-sum contrasts eigenvalue c_p=(p+1)(p+2)/(12D) multiplicity 2p−2, middle c_q=(q+1)(q+2)/(12D) multiplicity q−1, and 3×3 block-average matrix [[A,B,C],[B,T,B],[C,B,A]]. Reflection symmetry isolates antisymmetric λ_A=A−C and a 2×2 symmetric block with eigenvalues λ±. For F(z)=(S−z)(T−z)−2B², exact factorizations F(c_p)=−p(p+1)(p+q)(p−q+3)/(48D²), F(c_q)=pq(p²−q²−3q−3)/(24D²) determine the two integer switch intervals and unique q=p+3 tie of multiplicity 2p−1. F(λ_A)<0 puts it strictly between λ− and λ+; λ+ exceeds all contrasts. q=1 has no middle contrast; q≥2 has exact split at p−2/p−1, and outer switch/tie at p+3.
